subject.title: fix(codex): expose assistant completion idle timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.turnAssistantCompletionIdleTimeoutMs` as a public advanced configuration option?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the option works, but repository policy sets a high bar for expanding `openclaw.json`; only maintainers can accept the ongoing support and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Accept the public timer
options.body: Keep the default-preserving additive option and merge after the refreshed head passes required checks and base review.

options.title: Keep it internal only
options.body: Close the PR and continue using the direct runtime option for harness validation rather than adding another persistent config key.

recommendation.title: Accept the public timer
recommendation.body: Keep the default-preserving additive option and merge after the refreshed head passes required checks and base review.
